---
title: "CPU scaling"
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
lb_banner()
scaling <- lb_table("scaling")
```

Within-tool scaling: the same tool, tool version, workload, dataset and campaign
(machine), differing only in the number of CPUs requested.
`scaling_ratio` = median time at the baseline CPU count / median time at this CPU
count; `parallel_efficiency` = `scaling_ratio` × baseline CPUs / CPUs. Ratios are
not computed when timing boundaries or execution modes differ. These are not
cross-tool comparisons; `evidence` gives the weakest evidence tier involved.

```{r}
#| results: asis
lb_kable(scaling, c("workload", "dataset", "tool", "tool_version", "cpus", "baseline_cpus",
                    "n", "baseline_n", "evidence", "median_seconds", "sd_seconds",
                    "scaling_ratio", "parallel_efficiency", "reasons"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
if (!is.null(scaling) && nrow(scaling)) lb_plot_scaling(scaling)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
lb_download("scaling")
```
